topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Just when I thought I had a stable place to call home, the building is flipping to condos. Great, another reason to feel utterly helpless. I've barely settled in, made this place feel like it could be home, and now I have to deal with this? The meetings, the bids, the endless stream of strangers traipsing through what was my personal space. It's a waking nightmare, and all I want is a bit of peace, a place to breathe without someone trying to put a price tag on every square foot. Well, they can have their fancy renovations and their uptight HOA. I’ll be the one packing, looking for a new spot, but at least it won't be this circus anymore.
